linked_rows.title: Public provider intake and asset boundary
Task-matched conformance and reproducible benchmark evidence
Provider integration boundaries and build fragments

disposition: Whisper tiny.en plus MFA 3.4.3 text-aware transcription/alignment readiness blocker; no implementation, adapter, asset, runtime or result.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply tiny.en.pt with byte count and SHA-256 d3dd57d3..., the exact openai-whisper 20250625 source revision/package archive and the complete MIT license/notice bundle with an independent terms review.
exact_blockers.statement: The exact Whisper tiny.en weight is absent. The research record pins openai-whisper==20250625, tiny.en.pt and SHA-256 d3dd57d3..., but /private/tmp/whisper-model/tiny.en.pt is absent and no weight exists at a reviewed workspace or cache path. The upstream source revision, package archive digest and complete MIT notice bundle are not staged. No weight was downloaded or reconstructed.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the exact MFA 3.4.3 acoustic archive and dictionary with byte counts and SHA-256, the MFA source revision and license/notice text, a written CC-BY-4.0 attribution/output-use decision, and a pinned offline Conda environment.
exact_blockers.statement: No verified MFA asset or runtime is staged. The research report records MFA 3.4.3 with english_us_arpa acoustic and dictionary archive SHA-256 values and a CC-BY-4.0 model card, but those installed paths are outside this worktree and are not readable by this session; no digest was verified here, no MFA source revision/notice bundle is staged, and /private/tmp/mfa-env is absent.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply locked offline environments for openai-whisper 20250625 and MFA 3.4.3 with exact package/wheel/conda hashes, install and import digests, deterministic thread settings and a clean-room offline load trace.
exact_blockers.statement: No pinned runtime is present. The historical ASR environment /private/tmp/asr-mfa-env, the MFA environment /private/tmp/mfa-env and /private/tmp/mfa-root are absent; the available Python 3.11.5 interpreter exposes no whisper, torch, transformers or soundfile module. No lockfile, wheel/conda digest, import digest, thread policy or offline-load proof exists. No import, load or inference was attempted.

exact_blockers.required_action: Freeze the exact AMI EN2003a channel-0 crop, A.words annotation, meeting/channel mapping, source and annotation digests, reviewable AMI CC BY 4.0 terms, and an independent human-checked timing reference rather than reusing AMI forced alignment as gold.
exact_blockers.statement: The exact crop and annotation are absent. /private/tmp/EN2003a.Headset-0.wav, data/tmp/ami/.../EN2003a.A.words.xml and the entire data/runs/tsm-followup-20261101-mfa tree are absent, so the recorded crop SHA-256 a8fcab85... and the reference word spans cannot be verified. AMI terms are not reviewed and the AMI timings are themselves forced alignment, not independent timing gold.

exact_blockers.required_action: Run Whisper tiny.en and MFA 3.4.3 offline on the qualified crop with frozen ASR and boundary scorers, explicit token/substitution/deletion accounting, finite-output checks, a uniform-timing baseline and adverse/missing controls.
exact_blockers.statement: No ASR or alignment result was reproduced. The recorded 11.76% WER (4/34), 1.445 s CPU inference, 23.79 ms oracle boundary MAE, 23.17 ms ASR boundary MAE and 91.7% within-50 ms figures are quoted context only. No local WER, boundary score, matched-word accounting, finite-output scan or control baseline exists.

exact_blockers.required_action: After model/data/runtime/quality gates clear, measure the exact target-device paced workload, complete or explicitly waive the Rate profile with an independent review, and open a separate OFF-by-default versioned intake with exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No provider, tool, adapter or intake exists. The candidate has no SDK registration, no public ABI/registry/default/build or CI change, no target-device timing or resource measurement, and no reviewed rate-to-speed policy. The task row's Rate profile is a mismatch for a transcript/alignment tool, and every Rate row remains blocked.

non_claims: No Whisper weight, MFA acoustic model or MFA dictionary is present in this package.
No torch, openai-whisper, transformers, soundfile or MFA runtime is imported or executed.
No audio, transcript, word span, TextGrid or alignment artifact is read or scored.
No WER, boundary error, finite-output, baseline or timing result is reproduced.
No listening, device timing, benchmark, pipeline or release claim is made.
No provider, registry, descriptor, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
Recorded WER and boundary error are not independent timing gold or a preferred speed factor.

quality_outcomes.evidence: Recorded 11.76% WER is provenance only; no local score was reproduced.
Recorded 23.79 ms MAE is provenance only; no local alignment was reproduced.
Recorded 23.17 ms MAE and 91.7% within 50 ms are provenance only.
No local substitution/deletion/insertion accounting, OOV audit or finite-boundary scan exists.
Only a synthetic scorer-arithmetic control exists; no real baseline comparison exists.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: Whisper+MFA emits transcript and word boundaries, not rendered audio; no mapping or duration result exists.
No rendered waveform, F0/transient metric or listening result exists.
No playback chain, queue, fill/flush or buffering measurement exists.
No 1x or rate-change comparison exists; the tool is not a stretcher.
The historical evidence is one 15 s English AMI speech crop; no unfamiliar speech, music, silence or language coverage was tested.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include unfamiliar speech, music and silence.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No stream, rebuffer, clock-drift or partial-window behavior was measured.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: Word boundaries could inform a pause/filler controller, but no controller, source-timestamp policy or preservation measurement exists.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Keep pause or filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No preference/acceptability labels or rate-to-speed policy exists; WER and boundary error are not a preferred speed factor.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Map output to a reviewed preferred-speed policy.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Stage the exact crop, annotation and meeting/channel mapping, review AMI and MFA terms, and provide an independent human-checked timing reference.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Reproduce Whisper ASR and MFA alignment on the qualified crop with frozen scorers, exact token accounting, finite-output checks and matched control baselines.
release_gates.statement: No WER, boundary MAE/median/within-50 ms, matched-word accounting, finite-output scan or uniform-timing baseline was reproduced.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Score the exact Rate-profile cases with separate source references and a timestamp-tied pause/filler policy, or record a reviewed waiver because this tool is not a renderer.
release_gates.statement: The Rate profile is not exercised: no source/output mapping, duration, pitch/transient, buffering, rate-change, unfamiliar speech/music/silence, rebuffer/drift, final-partial-window or timestamp-tied pause/filler preservation evidence exists.
release_gates.title: rate_profile_condition_coverage

release_gates.statement: No target-device timing, CPU/memory/energy, queue, deadline or rebuffer measurement exists. The historical 1.445 s CPU inference is context only and not a device result.
release_gates.title: target_runtime_timing_resources_and_deadlines

release_gates.statement: No provider/tool intake or public-surface decision exists. The installed v0 geometry and shared build remain untouched.
release_gates.title: provider_intake_public_surface_and_release

The exact 15 s AMI EN2003a channel-0 crop, A.words annotation, meeting/channel mapping and reviewable AMI CC BY 4.0 terms.
A fresh offline Whisper tiny.en ASR run and MFA oracle/ASR alignments on the qualified crop with frozen scoring, finite outputs, matched-word accounting and control baselines.
A separate versioned opt-in SDK provider/tool intake with OFF default, empty descriptor settings, no registry/default/build change and independent exact-head review after every other gate clears.
